name: Literal hook demo
author: FullGram-IOS
summary: Replace tehh with the in plain outgoing cloud text.
limitations: Automatic literal replacements apply to plain cloud text only. Entity-bearing/formatted text (including links), media captions, secret chats and forwards are unchanged.
Replacement must be nonempty and must not expand UTF-8 or UTF-16 length. Enabled plugins run in installation order.
This file matched the complete literal-send-hook template. Python, Java, Xposed, external dependencies and additional statements are not executed.
